journal_lines: Slimes in the low ground. Messy.
Each one broke into two. Each two into none, eventually.
A pile of them under a low ceiling, jiggling at me like a question.
The big one was easy. The small ones were many.
Stepped wrong and slid through three of them. The four-legged way out is not always elegant.
Smelled like rain through an old screen. Looked like nothing.
They reformed when I looked away. I stopped looking away.
Soft and stubborn. Like a thing trying to remember its own shape.
Bounced once. Did not bounce again.
